notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.

notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/db35c03d0fda7640f3f2aeb39b155175281e3729.jpg[/img]
Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death. [p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: 
[previewyoutube=zVDyBBJkbxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

notes.title: Thanks for 2023!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40436977/25ad1e526d042bb4870ea8589e39a21699dd70b9.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, dear Mondealians and Dargrattians![/h3]

In 2023, after years of development, Mondealy has finally been released.
Without the support of the community, the game might never have been released, and by some miracle it was finished nonetheless, which honestly amazes me! The whole development process seems surreal now, I don't even know how I managed to create such a large project while basically being the only developer. But it would be wrong not to mention the many people who helped me along the way. My friends, acquaintances and fans, all of them somehow participated in the creation, even if only with a kind word. Special thanks go to the game's many musicians, who supported its unique and memorable style with their wonderful music. And of course thanks to each of you who are reading this text right now! A game without players can hardly be called a game. You are all very important to me!

Continuing with various thoughts - honestly, I expected something more from the game. Both from myself, in terms of its execution, and how it would prove itself upon release. And despite that, it could have been a lot worse! Many debut indie projects perform exceptionally poorly and barely break the ten sales mark. I'm lucky not to be on that extensive list of tragic projects and that's a great privilege. So, thank you to everyone who helped the game to become better known or created something related to it, even if there are not many of you, but I am very, very grateful to you all! I hope Mondealy has found its place in your hearts and was worth the wait.

The first few months after release I did nothing and rested, but I have a lot of plans and ideas that I want to execute with future projects. Some of them will be related to Mondealy characters, some won't, but I think you all have something to look forward to from me in the future. I will continue making games for many, many more years to come!

Thank you all! I hope to see you all in 2024! ːrufus_happyː

(Since English is not my main language, some parts were machine translated! Hope its not too weird! ːrassali_smirkː)

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 is out now
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! ːfroga_smugː

A game patch has been released. If you haven't completed the game, be wary of spoilers in the changelogs. Here are the notable changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed duplicate text in the localization files
[*] Fixed a "Variable Index out of range" crash during overlapping dialogues
[*] Fixed a possible Riley forest walk softlock
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the save menu
[*] Corrupt control settings will now cause the game to reset them to default
[*] Potential fix for the "Binding for gamepad is not supported" error
[*] The --livesplit launch parameter now works on Linux (though there is no native LiveSplit for Linux)
[*] Added a --nolinks launch parameter to hide social media links without rebuilding the game
[*] Upgraded the Steamworks SDK to v1.57 and the extension to latest from YoYo Games Ltd.
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the Riley book scene
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the menu
[*] Fixed a possible crash in the gallery
[*] Fixed a crash when loading any save from the Highton Vista
[/list]

If you encounter an issue multiple times and it doesn't go away on it's own, PLEASE report it to us on Discord.
That's it, enjoy Mondealy! ːcorsic_loveː

notes.title: Mondealy State of the Game - January 2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/114851e3bd6f6b3594af4b867fb8b49bceec1a71.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, dear players![/h2]

[b]New Year's holidays are over, I had a lot of rest and procrastination, but still managed to do some useful things for the game. Also, [i]another[/i] delay happened. 
Presumably, the game could finally be ready either around May, or after the summer, I can't give any more specific dates, because I'm really, really bad with them, which was obvious from the previous delays. 
But let's get to the good news and progress on the game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Changed the beach in front of the Water District[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/be134e674daef3b9474c27249f01c4f68798f034.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fd4c5c0b4cd4c7b783f024f0bd93ce8bf98b90de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/45d1e0f29dcad4058c8ee0d7a344e9fd1a30e4c3.png[/img]

The beach connected very poorly with the rest of the game world, so I decided to tweak it and connect it better to the other location. Also, I have removed the roots of the Dargratt tree from location's upper half, since it doesn't reach the beach to that extent.
The beach has its own "music" too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]The scenery on the lake now changes in real time[/h3]

The time of day in the game is now not controlled by  the story, but is fully dynamic. The lake scenery didn't fit this dynamic system, so I took some time to make a fully dynamic time change in the scenery itself as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/3e57ff2ddcafb8a5e0e2aadc652fb86caf8b2e17.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]FPS setting[/h3]

This setting rarely shows up in pixel games, and indie games in general, but I managed to add it and it even seems to be stable.
If you have a high refresh rate monitor this will make the game much smoother!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/9b09d6e3c11000fc039b1f4a8b700cf324c64de5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Improved follower movement[/h3]

Long time ago, followers would perfectly follow the path you traveled, including little zigzags and back and forth turns. I redesigned this system so that followers wouldn't blatantly follow you, repeating your path 1-to-1.
Later, I realized that small movements and turns in one place shouldn't cause a follower to run over behind you as well. Now they will wait quietly until you choose a new direction of movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/f19256e3505fa24deca51a954fefc115c5001d17.gif[/img]

Of course, you can now stop and just look at your follower. (They might even react to you staring at them)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Improved surface characters[/h3]

The game's dynamic time of day change had its costs - the characters would simply disappear when daytime changes.
I was able to make a much more interesting experience out of this, and now the characters come and go to their places at a certain point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/d9178b85dc954b8d9813a80d9ae6fba84e84474c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/77215ab95f2843cc759fef5e2dc5a4740a6b1f8e.gif[/img]

This is just one example of this character behavior in the world, there will be more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Story Progress[/h3]

Certain things will once again lead the protagonist to the Water District, but in a new role.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/5cd8943fb576ba49ac63a244251bc5dbe8437339.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/1cddd780f3d03193aba99e8f314141c4f1b8ec45.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Water District expansion[/h3]

Among other things, the Water District has now gotten a little bigger, going deeper towards the old factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/cc7b6629ce9176dbc856bbf84159a2d3cc809c76.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Draft for a quest with Froga[/h3]

I won't tell or show you much, but here's a screenshot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/8de170ee932c8f15ee3677d8be45956c809821ea.png[/img]

During this quest, the Froga will be a follower and walk with you everywhere. You can learn a lot about her, the Water District, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Changes in the Forest District[/h3]

In the midst of many improvements, I haven't forgotten about the Forest District, which has been made even prettier. Even with new locations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/2f30fd6d8506750ed0bb3e9e4f0438f6381e2c4f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/2c000d0727565d8e816451f96ca051566643759e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Other improvements[/h3]

Characters can now look at the protagonist and follow him with their heads, within some distance. (This is a detail I looked up in Hollow Knight)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/d0f101bab9dbda0c23a60646bc61d8d5a5211cc7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/c83125a7df75a58b4297a8751736e0a2935cdc6b.gif[/img]

Character leaving the location as night falls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/80d42200181bd90152ab3acb3e3949664918c716.png[/img]

The cars have a soft red glow from the taillights at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/4a827aa1bf162d1d277c6caa42c33c24c129e0a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/3969fa95711bf174a67696d4b5db0e5c508f2a8e.png[/img]

With a small chance, insects may fly out of the vegetation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/bf253210a786134c70ad72f164c3646496eddad3.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/e628e6153581a6ee745546242fd28eb45e7daf90.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]That's all folks![/h3]

[h3]Join the [url=https://discord.gg/mwR492aBfg]Discord server of the game[/url], it's the easiest place to contact me, the developer![/h3]
[h3]Or email mondealy.official@gmail.com[/h3]

Hope you enjoyed this post! Over the past months full of rest and procrastination, I've done quite a few secondary things, so the main story still needs time. Nevertheless, the game is slowly but surely getting closer to release. Thank you, for your continued attention and love of the game!

Sincerely,
uglycoal
:melon:

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/114851e3bd6f6b3594af4b867fb8b49bceec1a71.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, dear players![/h2]

[b]I've spent the past month focusing on the story, improving the old work in progress, and all sorts of other little things. This post will be smaller than the previous one, since there's a lot I can't show you, but here goes anyway![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements to the Save Menu[/h3]

Sometimes, I felt that text data alone wasn't enough, so I added a little picture to the saves, created at the moment of saving. And then I also cut the loading screen and replaced it with a smooth transition from that picture to the game (loading is almost instantaneous).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/f1cd548add6f2ccb060c77f3d28a30e45de7a77e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Mondealy State of the Game - October 2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/114851e3bd6f6b3594af4b867fb8b49bceec1a71.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, dear players![/h2]

[b]As much as I would love to create posts like this monthly, it doesn't always work out. Since then another person has joined the development team and is helping me with some aspects of the game, but it will only speed up development a little. The game now has an incredible number of people working on it - two! In the game itself, a huge number of different things have appeared or improved. Here are many things I can share without spoilers...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Game Intro... Again...[/h3]

The beginning greatly affects the overall impression of the game and whether or not it will draw the player in. Therefore, a lot of effort had to be taken away from the development of the main story to make intro the right length and more interesting. At the same time, the name of the Day One demo will now be justified, because it will really only have the first day (and not three as before)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/ae7986ca27be92735efc55d32bc6e5869317b7a3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Forest District[/h3]

Despite its natural beauty, the Forest District was hardly a point of attraction, not even for a pretty screenshot! Now that's not the case - by experimenting, we managed to create this kind of beauty:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fd8ab6b9a2114f184a628d4001ebc26eaa41f398.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/e88b4642c25b83f63e29acc5839878575c19252d.png[/img]

There's even a little lake there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/28a9c07430658ad79d7759e29437354155ce4a3e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Upcoming changes to Day One[/h3]

After the release of Mondealy, it's demo version Mondealy: Day One will remain free and it will include an absolutely identical beginning to the full version.

The Day One version's achievements will be removed from Steam so as not to duplicate them between the two games.
In addition, the gallery and achievement menus will be locked in Day One. 

But, the good news! You'll be able to port the gallery progress, achievements, and saves from the demo to the full game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Translations of Game Sprites[/h3]

The game already has Russian and English versions of all signs, banners, and other in-game stuff. And then I realized that the game won't be limited to these languages! And in general, the fan-made, even joke-based variants will only get better if they can translate the game sprites as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/ffe3dd874165da459435e644ed2340934f685015.png[/img]

Now it's possible, also in real time!
(Text translations remain as easy as they were. Unlike some other games)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Hints[/h3]

I really disliked the hints system in the old demo. It was a phone with oddly worded hints about what to do. At first I removed that element entirely, but later I realized that the hints were too important an aspect of player comfort to be thrown away like that. So I came up with something new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/41b962908437a5b7d8750f6aefaa52938ab78f0b.gif[/img]

After opening the hint menu by holding Q, you will see the hero's thoughts. Coincidentally, he's only thinking about how to go through the main story! (There is no specific hint in this gif)

Secondary quests will have no such hints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Gallery[/h3]

In the old demo, the gallery opened in real time and with all the character slides. Something I didn't like about this system, so I decided to redesign it. 
Now, during the first playthrough, every single interaction with a character (i.e. a conversation) will open them in the gallery. And it, in turn, will only be unlocked after you finish the game once. But don't worry, you'll be able to see who's locked and unlocked during the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/b2173ed3f6e457f78b127d46b046842608734fc4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Lighting and Graphics[/h3]

The demo had two kinds of lighting, simplified and unsimplified, this created a lot of development difficulties and I decided to remove the simplified lighting from the game. Now, it will be prettier, but probably perform worse on the weakest of computers. 
In addition, it will be possible to disable other shaders, which can put a strain on not the weakest computers as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/ff3ffc468101e1325c5cd12f57bee61118975a02.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/515c39ebf8865706b0de4610a8e8ceca4c4a1e0d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Main Story[/h3]

The game is about 70% complete. At the moment, I'm finalizing segments with Tori the deer, a character who doesn't appear in the demo. After that, there will be an extensive segment in the Water District and its new locations, and beyond that... And beyond that, you'll find out in the full game. I hope its pre-final segment doesn't disappoint you, as it seems extremely experimental to me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/51204d5e1970c080fb4bc7a93fb8bc494c76cc00.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/cdd1279c21f22d9443be0e60bf3e4d4692c50e20.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/24137956bf59aeb1340cf4b83207e5c8aec5d667.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Secondary Quests[/h3]

Not every character has enough screen time, so I plan to add additional storylines with some of them. As part of these "quests", you'll be able to get to know the characters better, in locations separate from the main world (the game doesn't become a dating simulator, it's still an adventure). 
This came to my mind after finishing Night in the Woods (cool game!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/a8588956f9facb2fbf97778462b81d581cc8468f.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/4f49c656f485f8ed1cc6d2450eebb91c39ec4faa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/383f064d2febd7bdf4fa188ea0b686bd8fd973df.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/32e46cc888773f045ee08b6ceff2d88640b71cf4.png[/img]

(Yes, Froga is very tall)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]Future Game Graphics Release[/h3]

Gaming communities like to collect old versions of game graphics. Also, they sometimes make fan content that uses the original game graphics. To save you the trouble of digging out all the sprites somehow, I plan to open up a GitHub repository containing the game graphics and all their older versions when the full game is released.

You'd get all those sprites anyway, so you'd better let me give you convenient access to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40218507/fa04b3e5e4df1b2e8597c3bae9c37c14f9b9d63b.png[/img]

[h3]That's all folks![/h3]

[h2]Add the full game to your wishlist if you haven't already![/h2]
(And check out the cool new poster.)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1620520/Mondealy/

[h3]And join the [url=https://discord.gg/mwR492aBfg]Discord server of the game[/url], it's the easiest place to contact me, the developer! [/h3]
[h3]Or email me at mondealy.official@gmail.com[/h3]

Time flies by. But the work goes on, and the game is getting closer to completion. And the recent delay has given me confidence in my abilities! I hope to deliver the best possible product. Thank you for your love and patient waiting!

Sincerely,
uglycoal
:melon:

notes.title: Play The Demo! Watch the Stream!
notes.notes:
[h2]Join us at the Steam Next Fest event and play the MONDEALY Demo![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40436977/7985b8b28b20993ccdebdf656c5d01db3e2e7464.gif[/img]
[h1]The story: [/h1]
[i]Assume the role of Michael - just an ordinary guy who managed to discover the pathways leading under his hometown, right into the unexplored underground kingdom of Dargratt. By a strange set of events and coincidences, Michael meets the royal family, now it’s up to them to decide what is going to happen with him next…[/i]

Get ready for:
[list]
[*] Romance and dating
[*] Deep, flamboyant, and sexy characters
[*] Choices and consequences
[*] Progression and skill system
[*] Main quests and side activities
